name: Three Root-Hole Contraction-Obstruction Families
statement: For every $d\ge4$, the families $\mathcal V_d$, $\mathcal W_d$, and $\mathcal Z_d$ are contraction-minimal nonlearning partial cubes. In dimension four they give representatives 4.2, 4.1, and 4.3, respectively. Together with $\mathcal T_d$, $\mathcal S_{d,t}$, and $\mathcal U_{d,r}$, their dimension-four members account for all ten contraction-minimal nonmembers in the computational catalogue; this finite completeness statement does not assert that the six schemes exhaust higher dimensions.
proof: The two truncated families are downsets, while the three-fiber family has explicit tight paths through its full base cube, so all are partial cubes. Rooted-union witnesses exclude every candidate root. Their contractions are cubes with one or two suitable vertices deleted, explicit union-closed lower-layer translates, or $P_3\square Q_{d-3}$, all learning-space graphs. Hence each family is contraction minimal.
